transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. It's really nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for fitting me in. 

Um... I guess I'm here because... well, I've been doing some kind of weird things at work lately. Nothing bad! I mean, I'm a bookkeeping clerk, so I'm usually very on top of things, but... I've just started doing some little things that don't exactly make sense? 

Like, um... I'll be sorting things and I'll start lining up receipts all across the floor instead of filing them. Or I'll catch myself tapping the calculator, you know, just tapping it in sets of nine. And... this is a little embarrassing to admit, but sometimes I'll just stand by the copier with my hands held up in the air, just kind of frozen there until someone comes by and asks if I'm okay. 

I know it probably sounds a little strange, but I promise it's not a huge deal or anything. I just wanted to make sure I'm doing the right thing by coming in to get it checked out. Is that... does that sound like the kind of thing I should be here for?
When you tap the calculator in sets of nine, does it feel like something you have to do to relieve a strong anxious thought or urge?

Oh, um... no, not really. It's not like an anxious thing or an urge I have to fight off, I don't think. It's just... I just sort of find myself doing it. 

Like, I'll just be sitting there, and it just happens. It doesn't feel bad or scary, just a little silly, really. I hope that's okay? I mean, I know it sounds a little odd, but I'm not, like, obsessing over it or anything like that. I just thought I should mention it because I want to give you all the right information. Does that make sense?
Have there been times lately when your mood felt unusually high or full of energy?

Um, well... I guess maybe a little? But usually in a good way, I think! There are some weeks where I just feel... really, really sharp. Like, almost unstoppable, honestly. I'll get this burst of energy and feel like I can just map out my entire future in a single night. It's actually kind of nice to feel that motivated, you know? 

But, um... I guess I should admit, there's a part of it I'm not super proud of. Sometimes when I'm feeling like that, if my boss or, like, a classmate gives me a small correction on something... I can get a little defensive. I might snap at them a bit harder than I mean to. 

I always feel terrible about it afterward, because I really try to be easy to work with! I promise I'm not a mean person, it just sort of bubbles over before I can catch it. Is it... does that sound like something I should be worried about? I hope it doesn't make me sound awful.
When you have those sharp, unstoppable periods, do you need much less sleep than usual?

Um, yeah, actually... I guess I do sleep a lot less during those times. But it doesn't feel like a bad thing! 

There have been a few times, like, I'll go for several nights only sleeping maybe two or three hours. But I still feel completely ready to go to work and to my classes. It's almost like... like sleep is just getting in the way, taking time away from getting my whole life figured out, you know? 

I know two or three hours doesn't sound like a lot, but I promise I'm not, like, falling asleep at my desk or anything. I'm still doing a good job! I just have so much energy that I don't really need the rest. Is that... is it okay that I don't need as much sleep sometimes? I hope that's not a huge problem.
Do the times when you freeze or line things up happen only when you're in those high-energy, low-sleep periods?

Um, no, actually. It's not just when I'm feeling all energized like that. 

Like, there was this one stretch... it was maybe a few weeks, I think? I was sleeping pretty normally, like a full night, and I didn't have that super sharp, unstoppable feeling at all. I felt pretty regular. But... um... I still felt really pulled into those number patterns. And... well, I still heard the voice, too. 

I hope that doesn't make things too complicated to figure out? I know it's probably easier if it all happens at the same time, but I really want to make sure I'm giving you the whole picture. I'm trying to be as helpful as I can, I promise. Does that make sense, though? Like, is it normal for that to happen even when my energy is fine?
What does the voice say?

Um... well, it's... it's really nothing too scary or mean, I promise. It's actually kind of helpful, in a weird way? 

Sometimes, like if I'm just sitting alone at my desk working on some bookkeeping stuff, or... or even just walking home from my classes, I'll hear this man's voice. And he just says really normal things, like... like, "check line seven," or "you missed the sign." 

It's... it's so clear that I usually turn around to see who's talking to me, even though I know I'm by myself. But it's not telling me to do anything bad! It's almost like having a little supervisor checking my work, you know? 

I know hearing things sounds really crazy, and I'm a little embarrassed to even admit it... I hope you don't think I'm completely losing my mind. It's just a regular voice, and I try not to let it bother me too much. Does that... is that an okay thing to experience? I mean, since it's not saying anything dangerous?
About how long have you been hearing that voice?

Um... gosh, let me think. I guess it's been a little while now. If I really look back on it, the voice... and, um, also that feeling I get about the numbers being like little messages... I think it's all been happening for about eight months now. 

I know that probably sounds like a long time to just keep it to myself, and I'm really sorry if I should have talked to a doctor sooner. I just... I didn't want to make a big fuss, you know? Since it wasn't keeping me from doing my bookkeeping or anything, I thought maybe it was just a quirk I could handle on my own without bothering anyone. 

I hope you're not frustrated with me for waiting so long to tell someone. I really am trying to do the right thing now. Eight months isn't too late to figure this out, is it?
Have you ever had one of those high-energy periods last a full week or longer?

Um, yeah, actually... they definitely have. There have been times where that feeling lasts for, well, maybe a whole week, or even a bit more. 

It's... it's actually kind of a nice feeling at first, if I'm being honest? Like, I feel unusually sharp, you know? Almost unstoppable. I'll stay up and feel like I can map out my entire future, just perfectly plan out everything in one night. It feels really productive, and I hope it doesn't sound too bad that I kind of enjoy that part of it. 

But... um... the downside is, and I feel a little bad admitting this, but... I can get a little touchy during those weeks. Like, if my boss at the bookkeeping job points out a tiny mistake, or if someone in my class just makes a small correction, I... I might snap at them. A lot harder than I mean to. 

I always feel terrible about it afterward, I promise. I really try to be a nice person, and I hate being short with people. I just... I get so wound up. Does that make sense? I hope you don't think I'm just a mean person... I'm really trying to get a handle on it. Is it normal to get a little snappy when your energy is that high?
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I definitely have days where I feel a little down or tired, like anyone else, I guess. But... but not for two whole weeks straight, and definitely not most of the day. 

I really try to keep a positive attitude, you know? I don't want to be a downer or let things get to me too much. So if I feel a little sad, I just try to focus on my bookkeeping or my classes and push through it. 

I hope that's okay? I mean, it's a good thing that I don't get super depressed like that, right? I just try to stay focused and not let myself wallow... I really want to be doing the right things to take care of myself.
Have you had the voice when you were not in one of those high-energy periods?

Um... yeah, I have. I hope that's the right answer, I just want to be honest with you. 

There was actually a stretch, um, maybe a few weeks or so, where I wasn't feeling all revved up like that. I was actually sleeping pretty normally, getting my eight hours, and I didn't have that unstoppable energy. I was just kind of... normal, I guess? 

But, um... even during that time, I was still hearing the voice. And I still felt really, you know, pulled into the patterns with the numbers. I tried really hard to just ignore it and focus on my work, but it was still there. 

Does that... is that helpful for you to know? I hope it doesn't make things too complicated for you to figure out. I just thought I should mention it since you asked.
Have you ever heard the voice during a time when you were not feeling especially energized or irritable?

Um, yes, I think we just touched on that, actually. I hope it's okay that I brought it up a second ago. 

But, yes, there was definitely a time—I think it was a few weeks, maybe—where I wasn't feeling all wound up or snappy at all. I was actually doing really well with my sleep, getting a normal amount of rest, and I wasn't feeling irritable with anyone at work or school. I was really trying to just be steady, you know?

But... yeah, the voice was still there during that time. And I still felt that strong pull to figure out the number patterns. I really did try my best to just push past it and be a good employee and student, but it didn't go away just because my energy leveled out. 

I hope I'm explaining that right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so you can help me. I don't want to be difficult.
For at least six months altogether, have you been hearing the voice or feeling that numbers carry special messages?

Um, yeah... I guess it has been a little longer than six months. I'm sorry, I hope it's not a bad thing that I waited this long to really talk about it. I'd say it's been going on for about eight months now? The voice, and... and feeling like the numbers are trying to send me messages. 

But I promise I've been trying really hard to just handle it on my own and not let it mess up my bookkeeping work. I just... I didn't want anyone to think I was weird or, you know, unstable. I really try to be a good employee and keep it to myself. 

Is that... does eight months make it a lot harder for you to help me? I really want to do whatever you think is best to fix it, I just hope I didn't mess things up by letting it go on for that long.
Was there ever a time when you heard the voice for at least two weeks while your mood felt completely normal?

Um, yes... I think that's actually the time I was trying to describe a minute ago. I'm sorry if I'm repeating myself, I just want to make sure I'm answering exactly what you're asking. 

But yeah, there was a stretch—maybe a few weeks, like you said—where my mood felt completely normal. I wasn't super energized, I was sleeping a normal amount, and I felt really level. But... I was still hearing the voice during that time. And I was still getting really pulled into the patterns with the numbers at work. 

I really tried to just push it away and do a good job, but it was still there even when my mood was fine. Does that... is that what you were looking for? I hope I'm giving you the right details.
